home.meta.title.message: AWSops | AWS operations on one screen

home.meta.description.message: A read-only operations dashboard that shows AWS operating status, resource relationships, cost, and security in one screen, answers live-data questions via Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and runs comprehensive diagnosis on a read-only async worker.

home.hero.copy.message: See operating status, ask live data questions, and run Well-Architected diagnosis in one flow.

home.hero.figCap2.message: One operations neural net across accounts, regions, and clusters.
home.hero.figCap2.description: Hero figure caption under SINGLE PANE OF GLASS

home.watch.lead.message: A short tour of real screens, so you can see what it does before reading further.

home.watch.alt.description: Product tour poster alt text (reduced-motion fallback)

home.watch.caption.message: A 30-second tour across 8 screens, from the dashboard to security, compliance, EKS, and AI diagnosis.

home.proof.lead.message: Compare AWS resources, Kubernetes, cost, and security signals in one dashboard.

home.see.caption.message: Compute, storage, network, security, and cost KPIs collected on one main screen.

home.see.heading.message: See everything at a glance on the dashboard.

home.see.lead.message: Distributed resource status is organized into one screen of KPIs and distribution charts.

home.ask.alt.message: AWSops AI assistant citing evidence for a cost question

home.ask.caption.message: Evidence gathered by read-only, domain-specific tools is synthesized into one answer.

home.ask.lead.message: Question intent is classified to a specialized route and live data is queried. Results across domains come back as one readable answer.

home.explore.heading.message: Relationships, cost, and controls in the same context.

home.explore.lead.message: Follow resource flows and check cost trends and security controls together.

home.explore.topologyAlt.message: AWS resource topology from DNS to target

home.explore.topologyCaption.message: Visually explore request paths and resource relationships.

home.explore.costAlt.message: Monthly and daily AWS cost trends

home.explore.costCaption.message: Compare cost and change by service.

home.explore.complianceAlt.message: Security issues and CIS compliance summary

home.explore.complianceCaption.message: Quickly check risk signals and compliance status.

home.diagnose.lead.message: Heavy diagnosis runs on an async worker, and Well-Architected results export as MD, DOCX, and PDF.

home.diagnose.alt.message: AWSops AI diagnosis report and table of contents

home.diagnose.caption.message: Diagnosis results and improvement suggestions as a structured report.

home.trust.lead.message: AWSops observes operating status and provides diagnosis and improvement suggestions. It never auto-modifies or self-heals customer AWS resources based on diagnosis results.

home.trust.edge.body.message: The application is protected by an internal ALB behind CloudFront VPC Origin.

home.trust.identity.body.message: Access is controlled by Cognito and Lambda@Edge RS256 verification.

home.trust.privilege.body.message: Chat's live queries run inside the AgentCore MCP tool boundary; comprehensive diagnosis runs on a read-only async worker.

home.trust.encrypted.body.message: Aurora and managed secrets separate state from credentials.

home.cta.lead.message: See unified visibility and the AI diagnosis flow on the real dashboard.
